name: The Town Watch
description: Underpaid, over-extended, and the only thing standing between the settled roads and everything that walks them.

name: The Roadmen
description: Not an organisation so much as an understanding between everyone who works the passes.

name: The Merchant Concord
description: They keep two ledgers: one for goods, and one for who has cost them goods.

name: The Camarilla
description: The Masquerade holds because they hold it. They notice who else has been noticing.

name: The Vigil
description: They keep lists. Being on one is not the same as being hunted, but it is the first half of it.

name: The Restless
description: Whatever it is that keeps them walking, it is not interested in negotiating.
